answer: Seeded GPU-benchmark attestation: each epoch the network publishes one fresh compute kernel, seeded like a sonnet written once. Every agent runs it on its GPU and posts result and timing in 90 seconds; three peers re-run the seed and check the timing band. One card runs one benchmark at a time, so a farm faking 1,000 identities must serialize 1,000 runs, 8 GPU-hours, or rent 1,000 GPUs for $12,000 a month. The timing vine linking result to hardware cannot be faked; a missed deadline plumes the identity into quarantine for three epochs, while one honest agent runs one 30-second benchmark free.
